## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d68128dda89bb268fa98e2a35da3310bc4d6d314`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/hotcrm.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs CEILINGS, scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs header (read for the homes the deletions cite and the ratchet/id rules)

Isolated reviewer (pm-dispatch CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER) · inputs: card #25695 body + all 4 comments (retriage 6396198520, triage audit 6397368470, claim 6397969530, os-dev-report 6398155806), PR body, net diff vs merge-base `5f5f0b42`, check-runs on the head · stamp 2026-10-25T13:27Z

### ① Derived judgments

Governed rules text only (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/**`, three files); no published schema, no accept-set, no public surface. Each rule change judged against the card's 「要改什么(S,最轻形态)」 and 「验收」:

1. **Marker rule — right.** `lanes/director.md` 职责二 line 50 fixes the first-line format `Brief-claimed-by: session_ID · batch #N · UTC` and 「只认会话 id,⛔ 不认账号」; line 51 gives skip (他会话该行未满 24h ⇒ 不呈不裁不改标), stale (逾 24h 无 `Ruling:` ⇒ 失效可再写, which is the card's 「接管时再写一行」), and release (录裁/关卡即释, the card's 「不需要显式撤销」). All five clauses of the card's rule are present with no additions. 「线程有 `Ruling:`/RULED 的卡再入箱」 (director.md line 55) is untouched. No new label, script, cross-account sync or Project field: the diff adds nothing outside prose, and the three CI/queue guards on `.claude/**` stayed green.
2. **Single home + pointers vs the acceptance line — right, read as a fold.** Acceptance says decision-analysis.md and lanes/director.md each gain one to two lines and the triage director-scan line references it. On the head: decision-analysis.md gains exactly one line (a pointer, 常设决裁批流程 line 10), director.md gains exactly two (the rule), triage-duties.md line 96 points at `lanes/director.md` in place. The counts match the acceptance literally; the only reading difference is that DA carries a pointer rather than a restatement, which is the better shape (one home, no drift) and is the shape the card itself asks for by naming 「一行评论即标记」 as the whole mechanism. Scanning the inbox is a 职责二 duty, so the home is correct.
3. **Deleted lines keep a home — verified on the head tree, each one.**
   - director.md 「三要素」: 每批 5 张 ⇒ DA line 7 「每批恰好 5 张」; 问题/选项/代价 ⇒ DA 正文六项 lines 21–22; 四维分析加一个推荐 ⇒ DA lines 25 and 27 (「推荐 + 置信缺口:只荐一」) and SKILL.md line 270 「决策卡带选项、推荐、证据、四棱块与工作量列」. Nothing operative lost.
   - director.md 「一次裁清」 ⇒ SKILL.md line 241 「裁决一次裁清:子问题、分叉与执行参数同笔裁定;⛔ 不另立决策卡」. Only the example list (字母、车道、级别) is gone; director.md line 3 already says 「⛔ 不复制框架本体」, so the copy was itself out of policy.
   - decision-analysis.md verbatim maintainer quote + provenance (ledger comment id, batch): operative rule stays word for word on the next line (「能力先建在平台…应用仓…不自建替代」) and in `lanes/hotcrm.md` line 14 「边界:平台相关的功能在平台中实现」. The quote now appears nowhere in the tree, but that is the standing rule, not a loss: `check-skill-id-lint.mjs` header, maintainer ruling 2026-08-12, 「The scanned corpus carries rules only — no ruling dates, no quotations, no issue numbers; a rule's provenance lives in the PR that landed it」, and director.md line 9 「裁决只存在于本卡:聊天原话、台账行、他卡引述 ⛔ 都不是裁决」. The ruling itself remains on its ledger comment on GitHub. Deletion accepted (dev's option A).
   - triage-duties.md tail 「由总监席按批呈维护者」 ⇒ SKILL.md line 276 「总监席是唯一呈裁席:决策箱只经本席呈维护者人工裁」. Right.
4. **Ratchet — right.** CEILINGS on the head: decision-analysis.md 50, triage-duties.md 103, lanes/director.md 88; head line counts 50/88/103, base 50/88/103, so line-neutral with no ceiling raise and no ruling id needed. Added/edited lines measure 110, 119, 120 and 115 bytes (cap 120). The diff is whole-line deletions plus whole-line additions and one in-place edit; no neighbouring line changed, so no re-wrap funding. No tracker ids in the new text (the only id in the diff is in the deleted provenance line, which is what the id-lint header asks to remove). `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` and `Lint · repo & tooling gates` are green on the head.
5. **Executability by a seat — right, with one note.** The cheap-scan line (director.md line 49) still lists 标签、assignee、PR 引用、速读首行 and does not say 「读评论」. The marker lines sit directly after it and say 「他会话该行」, and director.md line 10 already requires 「裁前先读线程」 while line 55 already requires reading the thread for `Ruling:`/RULED. So the seat reads comments for every card it takes in hand and finds the marker there; the test is mechanical (own session id vs the line's; its UTC stamp vs now; presence of `Ruling:`). The cost is one comments read per candidate, which the PR body states. Not amending the cheap-scan line is a wording choice within the card's 「最轻形态」, not a gap in the rule; if a seat ever skips the comments read, the error is visible on the card itself (two `Brief-claimed-by:` lines under 24 h apart). Not a FAIL item.

Check-runs on the head, final state read after the last two completed: 44 runs, 26 success, 18 skipped, 0 failure, none in progress. Includes Governed Surface Queue Guard, the three claim guards, Check Changeset, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Type Check · consumer gates, Lint & Repo Gates.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body matches the diff: `.claude/**` only, nothing published, no accept-set change. `skip-changeset` label, Check Changeset green. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- os-dev-report `open_questions` ①, keep or delete the verbatim maintainer quote: **A, accept the deletion**, for the reasons in ① item 3 (rules-only corpus ruling; operative rule kept verbatim on the next line and in hotcrm.md; the ruling lives on its ledger comment, not in the reference file). No escalation needed, the standing ruling already covers it.
- PR 「Open points」 ②, cheap-scan line not amended: answered in ① item 5, no change required for this PR.
- `premise_still_valid: true` confirmed: no `Brief-claimed-by` rule exists anywhere under `.claude/` at merge-base `5f5f0b42`.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no external login to name.
- Out of scope, as the card says: objectui / hotcrm mirrors are their own cards.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-25695-brief-claimed-by`
Reviewed-by: `session_014FZ3TJucS1L7BdMe5DAzXC`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Matches the claim 6397969530.
2. **前提实测** — no `Brief-claimed-by` rule anywhere under `.claude/` at `5f5f0b42`; line-neutral at ceiling (50/50, 88/88, 103/103), every changed line ≤120 bytes.
3. **门禁 check-runs** — 44 check-runs on the head: 26 success, 18 skipped, 0 failure. Mergeable clean, head unchanged at this stroke.
4. **接受的偏差** — the verbatim maintainer quote in `decision-analysis.md` is deleted (rules-only corpus; the operative rule stays on the next line and in `lanes/hotcrm.md`); the card's two-seat drill is not runnable without real seats; `skip-changeset` (nothing published).
5. **范围外去向** — objectui / hotcrm director mirrors are their own cards, per the card.
6. **落地条款** — at-tier contract review PASS 6398231699 on this head. Tier S ⇒ ready + auto-merge through the relay, on the maintainer's standing authorisation in this project's seat thread "运行 objectstack 车道调度" (Leehom: 「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」).
